# AI Workflow

AI can help students move faster, but the point of the course is to become more responsible, not more casual.

## Useful AI tasks

- Convert a CDS PDF table into a draft CSV row.
- Explain a model formula in `fixest`.
- Generate data validation checks.
- Review code for joins that duplicate rows.
- Draft a plain-language interpretation of a coefficient.

## Banned AI shortcuts

- Do not ask AI to invent missing data.
- Do not cite a source AI has not linked and you have not opened.
- Do not paste a result into your paper without rerunning the code.
- Do not let AI choose the treatment definition without checking the paper.

## Prompt pattern

Use this pattern:

```text
I am replicating Walker et al. (2023). Here is my data dictionary.
Here is my R code.
Here is the error or output.
Please identify possible causes, but do not rewrite the whole project.
Give me checks I can run before changing the model.
```

## Verification pattern

Every AI log entry should include:

- prompt
- AI output summary
- what you accepted
- what you rejected
- how you verified it

Use `prompts/ai_prompt_log_template.md`.
